reason: The cited evidence supports the protective role of Cr2O3 (E1) and Cr vulnerability in nuclear environments (E2), but none of the passages address grain-boundary-mediated Cr diffusion, self-healing dynamics, or the effect of grain refinement on passive film stability—these key mechanistic premises lack specific prior support.
